description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper for recipes from Smitten Kitchen. It includes functions to fetch and parse recipe data from specific web pages, utilizing external libraries like 'request' and 'cheerio'. It exports a main function 'smittenKitchen' that returns a Promise resolving to a recipe object.

methods.name: smittenKitchen
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe data, returning a Promise.

methods.name: oldSmitten
methods.description: Helper function to parse older style recipe pages from Smitten Kitchen.

methods.description: Helper function to parse newer style recipe pages from Smitten Kitchen.
